mapper.sql: id, email, password_hash, display_name, job_role, goal, level, native_language, timezone, reminder_time, onboarded_at, failed_login_attempts, locked_until, email_verified_at, role, banned_at, course
mapper.select: SELECT timezone FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, display_name) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName}, display_name), job_role = COALESCE(#{jobRole}, job_role), goal = COALESCE(#{goal}, goal), timezone = COALESCE(#{timezone}, timezone), reminder_time = COALESCE(#{reminderTime,jdbcType=TIME}, reminder_time), course = COALESCE(#{course}, course), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET level = #{level}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET onboarded_at = COALESCE(onboarded_at, #{at}), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE users SET locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_login_attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN #{lockUntil} ELSE locked_until END, failed_login_attempts = CASE WHEN failed_login_attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 0 ELSE failed_login_attempts + 1 END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET email_verified_at = COALESCE(email_verified_at, #{at}), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET failed_login_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND (failed_login_attempts <> 0 OR locked_until IS NOT NULL)
